basic_details.scholarship_name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Distributed & Big Data Engineering (DEDS)
basic_details.offering_entity: European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA) & DEDS Consortium
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Université Libre de Bruxelles (ULB - Belgium), CentraleSupélec / Université Paris-Saclay (France), Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC - Spain), Technische Universität Berlin (TU Berlin - Germany)
degree_levels: Master of Science (MSc / Joint or Double Degree)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Distributed Computing, Big Data Management, Cloud and Edge Architectures, Scalable Data Engineering, Machine Learning Systems.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~18 to 22 prestigious Erasmus Mundus scholarship grants awarded globally per cohort
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally under Partner Country quota; typically 2 to 4 Pakistani scholars selected per intake
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 24 months (2 full academic years across at least two European countries)

nationality_requirements: Open to candidates from all countries worldwide, including Pakistan (Partner Country category)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restrictions under Erasmus Mundus programme regulations.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor of Science (BS / BSc 16-year) degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Science, Informatics, or related engineering discipline with minimum CGPA 3.60 / 4.00 (82%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.60 / 4.00 or top 10% class rank; highly competitive program where admitted candidates often hold CGPA >= 3.80 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Solid background in distributed systems, computer architecture, databases, operating systems, data structures, algorithms, and advanced programming (C/C++, Java, or Python).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or enrolled in final undergraduate year graduating by July 31 preceding September intake.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of graduation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Industry experience in distributed databases, cloud engineering, or open-source software engineering enhances application score.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic overall minimum 6.5 (with at least 6.0 in each sub-score) or TOEFL iBT minimum 90 (at least 20 in each section). MOI certificate is not accepted under DEDS consortium rules.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Consortium languages (French, Spanish, German) are not required prior to admission; language modules provided during mobility.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Erasmus Mundus NDICI / IPA III Partner Country scholarship quota applies to Pakistani nationals.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Candidates who have previously benefited from an Erasmus Mundus Master or Doctoral scholarship are not eligible.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver across all participating host universities (EUR 18,000 for non-EU students).

admission_application_fee.details: Direct application through the DEDS consortium portal is free of charge.

accommodation.details: Covered directly from the EUR 1,400 / month living allowance; partner universities assist with student residence reservations.

monthly_stipend.details: EUR 1,400 / month tax-free living allowance for up to 24 months (total EUR 33,600 | ~PKR 425,000 / month).

airfare.details: EUR 3,000 per year travel and mobility contribution for Partner Country students living >4,000 km away.

visa_fee.details: EUR 1,000 installation grant covers visa processing, medical attestations, and initial arrival logistics.

health_insurance.details: Full worldwide comprehensive health, emergency, and travel insurance meeting Erasmus+ requirements.

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly EUR 1,400 living stipend plus access to subsidized European university restaurants.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to electronic library resources and course materials across all consortium universities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Master thesis internship stipends in partner industrial research labs (e.g. IBM, INRIA, Siemens, CERN).

travel_transit_allowance.details: Mobility travel grant between consortium host nations (Brussels, Paris, Barcelona, Berlin).
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Covered via Erasmus mobility travel budget

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host institutions (Erasmus Mundus Consortium: ULB Brussels, CentraleSupélec/Paris-Saclay, UPC Barcelona, TU Berlin).
participating_institutions: Université Libre de Bruxelles (ULB - Brussels, Belgium)
Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC - Barcelona, Spain)
Technische Universität Berlin (TU Berlin - Berlin, Germany)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 100 worldwide engineering universities; leading European institutions in computer engineering and big data.
available_majors: DEDS Track 1: Distributed Data Pipelines (ULB & UPC)
DEDS Track 2: Scalable Cloud Architectures (CentraleSupélec & TU Berlin)
DEDS Track 3: Data Analytics & Big Data Systems (ULB & TU Berlin)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Engineering (CGPA >= 3.60/4.00), official IELTS Academic (min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 90), CV, statement of purpose, two academic references via online portal.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Consortium-wide admissions selection; candidates must indicate mobility track preferences during application.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Demonstrate strong hands-on coding and systems coursework (distributed algorithms, operating systems, networking, databases).

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the DEDS portal, select preferred study track, complete academic history, upload attested degree transcripts, CV, statement of purpose, English test score, and register two academic referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review DEDS mobility tracks, curriculum modules, and admission criteria on the consortium portal.
Step 2: Prepare all required documents including degree certificates, official transcripts, CV, statement of purpose, and English test scores.
Step 3: Register on the official DEDS Online Application System and select study track preferences.
Step 4: Submit online application before the scholarship deadline (December 31).
Step 5: Undergo rigorous review by the joint Academic Selection Committee (ULB, CentraleSupélec, UPC, TU Berlin).
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an online technical interview in February.
Step 7: Consortium publishes initial ranking and sends scholarship nomination to European Commission (EACEA) in March.
Step 8: Final scholarship award notification delivered in April; candidates receive formal admission and visa facilitation letters.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Routing: Single consolidated application for both degree admission and Erasmus Mundus scholarship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two university academic professors directly via referee invitation link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose detailing academic background in distributed computing, reasons for choosing DEDS, and career vision.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Brief outline of desired thesis topic or domain within big data systems and distributed data engineering.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass format CV highlighting software engineering projects, system skills, and academic achievements.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview with consortium faculty probing systems knowledge and algorithm design.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (min 6.0 each) or TOEFL iBT 90+ (min 20 each).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Pakistani applicants.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translation for all academic records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via DEDS consortium portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
Full transcript of academic records showing all coursework and credit hours.
Europass format CV emphasizing coding proficiency, database projects, and publications.
Max 2-page essay highlighting technical background, motivation for DEDS, and chosen mobility track.
Confidential recommendation letters from university professors submitted directly via portal.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From undergraduate thesis supervisor or department chair.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS Academic (minimum 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (minimum 90) test certificate.
Valid Pakistani passport and residency certificate.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Scholarship applications close December 31; self-funded applications remain open until April 30.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 45% (Academic performance, mathematical rigor, and computing foundation)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Quality of motivation letter, relevant projects, and research orientation)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Software engineering internships, cloud or devops experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of vision and alignment with consortium tracks)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (Online technical discussion or video statement assessment)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Joint Academic Selection Committee comprising representatives from ULB, CentraleSupélec, UPC, and TU Berlin.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Consortium scoring grid evaluating previous curriculum match, GPA, SOP, references, and interview performance.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in CS or SE with outstanding GPA, deep systems knowledge, and hands-on experience in big data or distributed platforms.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, and GIKI.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Nigeria, Brazil, Turkey, Colombia, Vietnam.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply via the official DEDS consortium portal https://deds.ulb.ac.be/.
Beware of scam consultants claiming backdoor entry or guaranteed Erasmus Mundus spots.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for the Erasmus Mundus DEDS scholarship is completely free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: No recruitment agencies or educational consultants are affiliated with the DEDS consortium.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Apostille and HEC degree attestation charges in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 - 25,000.
Initial visa application fee in Islamabad prior to arrival (reimbursed via €1,000 installation grant).
Transit travel between consortium partner countries (subsidized by €3,000/year travel grant).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You must already know French, Spanish, or German to apply. Reality: All coursework across ULB, CentraleSupélec, UPC, and TU Berlin is taught 100% in English.
Myth: Erasmus Mundus requires returning to your home country immediately. Reality: There is zero return obligation; scholars can work across Europe or globally.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sources advertise that MOI is acceptable; the DEDS consortium strictly enforces official IELTS or TOEFL score reports.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must successfully earn 60 ECTS credits each academic year to progress between mobility tracks.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time attendance across all consortium university modules and partner company workshops.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Joint Consortium Academic Board monitoring at the end of each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not engage in full-time outside employment that compromises academic participation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of scholarship and recovery of unspent funds in case of withdrawal or academic failure.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Mobility tracks are determined upon admission; changes permitted only under exceptional academic circumstances with board approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Not applicable to joint master's programme.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is strictly capped at 24 months.
